verify.test: bash -c 'bad=$( { jq empty $(git ls-files "*.json") 2>&1 || echo "INVALID JSON"; jq -r ".plugins[] | (.skills // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sort -u | while read -r p; do [ -f "$p/SKILL.md" ] || echo "BAD SKILL $p"; done; jq -r ".plugins[] | (.commands // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sort -u | while read -r p; do case "$p" in *.md) [ -f "$p" ] || echo "MISSING COMMAND $p";; *) echo "NO .md EXTENSION $p";; esac; done; grep -Fxf skill/work-pr/SKILL.md skill/work-issue/SKILL.md | awk "length > 60" | grep -vFxf docs/shared-lines-allowlist.txt | sed "s/^/DUPLICATED /"; } ); [ -z "$bad" ] && echo "structural checks pass" || { echo "$bad"; exit 1; }'
